title: Uber Retreats in Africa as Cost Comes Before Comfort and Safety

title: India Protests Set to Continue Despite Heavy Delhi Security
title_cn: India Protests Set to Continue Despite Heavy Delhi Security
summary: Parts of New Delhi remained under tight security for a second straight day as protesters pressed ahead with their demand for the resignation of India’s top election official over a contentious revision of voter rolls.

title: Healey Plans Short-Term UK Budget Giveaways to Limit Fiscal Pain
title_cn: Healey Plans Short-Term UK Budget Giveaways to Limit Fiscal Pain
summary: Chancellor of the Exchequer John Healey wants to help British voters with the cost of living while staying within the limits of his country’s stretched public finances. To square this circle, he’s planning a series of strictly short-term giveaways — and hoping the war in Iran comes to an end.

title: Taiwan’s Lai Urges Democracies to Unite After Trump-Xi Talks
title_cn: Taiwan’s Lai Urges Democracies to Unite After Trump-Xi Talks
summary: Taiwanese President Lai Ching-te called on democracies in the region to unite against threats to stability, as the island faces pressure from Beijing and concerns that US President Donald Trump’s rapprochement with China could come at Taiwan’s expense.

title: China Issues Draft Standards for Remanufactured Automotive Parts
title_cn: China Issues Draft Standards for Remanufactured Automotive Parts
summary: China released draft rules that would establish nationwide requirements for automotive-parts remanufacturing, including standards for the sourcing of used components, product quality, traceability and market oversight.

title: India’s Rupee Defense Raises Question of How Far RBI Will Go
title_cn: India’s Rupee Defense Raises Question of How Far RBI Will Go
summary: The Reserve Bank of India is broadening its defenses to steady the rupee, taking some of its strongest measures since the 2013 taper tantrum. That may give the currency a boost as trading resumes Monday, but the question remains: how far is the central bank willing to go as external pressures mount?

title: Once-Hot AI Trade Leaves Korean Stocks Struggling for Buyers
title_cn: Once-Hot AI Trade Leaves Korean Stocks Struggling for Buyers
summary: South Korea spent much of this year as a poster child of the scorching global AI trade. Now, by almost every measure, the $4.3 trillion stock market is rapidly losing relevance with investors.

title: AI Debt Issuance Defies Rising Yields as SpaceX, Broadcom Plan Major Deals
title_cn: AI Debt Issuance Defies Rising Yields as SpaceX, Broadcom Plan Major Deals
summary: When financing gets more expensive, companies usually slow down their bond sales. Tech companies have instead been ramping up this year, and talk this week of potential big financings from SpaceX and Broadcom Inc. only amplified investor fears about the wave of coming debt.

title: Strong Earnings Keep US Stocks in Favor
title_cn: Strong Earnings Keep US Stocks in Favor
summary: PNC Asset Management Chief Investment Officer Amanda Agati tells Bloomberg This Weekend that strong corporate fundamentals and resilient consumer spending could support US stocks as investors head into third-quarter earnings season. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Agati says investors will be watching for evidence that AI investment is generating returns beyond the largest technology companies, while strong US earnings growth keeps her favoring domestic equities over developed international markets. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Phenomenal Time To Be Investor, Not Consumer: Amoroso
title_cn: Phenomenal Time To Be Investor, Not Consumer: Amoroso
summary:
Anastasia Amoroso, chief investment strategist with Partners Group, joins Scarlet Fu and Tom Keene on "Bloomberg Money." They discuss the bullish sentiment in the stock market, the potential for volatility in the near future, and rising global yields.
 (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Pointed! Bloomberg's Weekly News Quiz For Risk-Takers
title_cn: Pointed! Bloomberg's Weekly News Quiz For Risk-Takers
summary: Pointed offers a strategic twist to the news quiz format, testing not just players’ knowledge of the news but also their confidence in their answers. Join Bloomberg's Lisa Mateo, Christina Ruffini and David Gura as they play and check out the quiz for yourself at Bloomberg.com (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Viral Handbags Turn Small Designer Into Fashion Star
title_cn: Viral Handbags Turn Small Designer Into Fashion Star
summary: New York Handbag Designer Pierre Laborde tells Bloomberg This Weekend that a viral TikTok video transformed his handmade leather bags from a longtime fixture at a local street market into a sought-after fashion accessory, with demand now exceeding his small team's production capacity. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Laborde says he plans to preserve the individuality and craftsmanship of his designs rather than pursue mass production or partnerships with major retailers.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: By The Way: Headlines You May Have Missed
title_cn: By The Way: Headlines You May Have Missed
summary: The growing debate over video calls on airplanes, premium California wines selling at steep discounts under supermarket private labels, a new rivalry between New York diners featuring singing waiters and the growing popularity of elaborate tuna carving experiences at high-end sushi restaurants. Join Lisa Mateo, David Gura and Christina Ruffini for a roundup of headlines you may have missed, but gotta see. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Hurricane Isaias May Cost Insurers Billions
title_cn: Hurricane Isaias May Cost Insurers Billions
summary: Bloomberg Intelligence Senior Insurance Equity Analyst Matthew Palazola tells Bloomberg This Weekend that Hurricane Isaias could generate insured losses in the single-digit billions of dollars, with stronger Florida building codes potentially limiting damage despite rising property values. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Palazola says two relatively mild hurricane seasons have helped insurers rebuild capital, while recent Florida insurance reforms have improved market conditions but have yet to face a major test. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Russia Plague Scare Raises Public Health Questions
title_cn: Russia Plague Scare Raises Public Health Questions
summary: Baylor College of Medicine Tropical Medicine Expert Dr. Peter Hotez tells Bloomberg This Weekend that the unexplained death of a researcher at a Russian plague institute raises questions about a possible pneumonic plague infection, although there is no evidence of a wider outbreak or biological weapons activity. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Hotez calls for an independent World Health Organization investigation and warns that the US lacks adequate plague vaccine preparedness. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Russian Diesel Deal Unlikely to Lower US Prices
title_cn: Russian Diesel Deal Unlikely to Lower US Prices
summary: Bloomberg Economics Economic Statecraft Lead Chris Kennedy tells Bloomberg This Weekend that President Donald Trump's agreement to obtain Russian diesel is unlikely to significantly lower US fuel prices because the proposed November shipment amounts to roughly one day of American consumption. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Kennedy says damage to Russian refineries, logistical challenges and potential legal restrictions raise questions about whether Moscow can deliver the promised fuel, while the agreement could complicate Ukraine's campaign against Russian energy infrastructure. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Banana Ball Takes Its Baseball Show Nationwide
title_cn: Banana Ball Takes Its Baseball Show Nationwide
summary: Banana Ball Championship League Owner Jesse Cole tells Bloomberg This Weekend that the Savannah Bananas have built a new kind of baseball experience around faster games, elaborate entertainment and affordable tickets, helping create a wait list of roughly 5 million fans. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Cole says the league plans to keep expanding its audience in the US and internationally while maintaining its fans-first model, including $35 tickets without added fees and free game streams on YouTube. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Balancing Conviction and Risk: Masters in Business  with Maria Vassalou
title_cn: Balancing Conviction and Risk: Masters in Business  with Maria Vassalou
summary: Barry speaks with Maria Vassalou, Head of the Pictet Research Institute.  They discuss her research into global markets, and how they balance geopolitical risk. They also discuss China's growth as a technical innovator, and the risks to US debt. Finally, Barry and Maria discuss the differences between investing research and academia.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Restaurant Theft Adds to Rising Dining Costs
title_cn: Restaurant Theft Adds to Rising Dining Costs
summary: Bloomberg Pursuits Food Editor Kate Krader tells Bloomberg This Weekend that diners are taking everything from silverware and glassware to artwork and bathroom fixtures, adding replacement costs for restaurants already struggling with tight profit margins. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Krader also discusses the return of late night dining in cities including New York and London as restaurants extend their hours and customers embrace later reservations.  (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Hurricane Isaias Slams Florida Panhandle
title_cn: Hurricane Isaias Slams Florida Panhandle
summary: AccuWeather Correspondent Bill Wadell joins hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini on Bloomberg This Weekend from Pensacola Beach, Florida, where Hurricane Isaias made landfall as a Category 2 storm, bringing damaging winds, flooding and widespread power outages across the Gulf Coast. Wadell says the storm has weakened as it moves inland, but downed power lines, debris and continued flooding remain concerns as crews begin restoring electricity and assessing the damage. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Apple Supplier Luxshare Expects No Material Impact From US Probe
title_cn: Apple Supplier Luxshare Expects No Material Impact From US Probe
summary: Apple Inc. supplier Luxshare Precision Industry Co. is facing a US patent investigation into data-center power technologies following infringement allegations by Vicor Corp., according to a filing on Saturday.

title: Nvidia Explores Deal Options With Reflection AI, Financial Times Says
title_cn: Nvidia Explores Deal Options With Reflection AI, Financial Times Says
summary: Nvidia Corp. is in talks to boost its investment in Reflection AI or offer the startup computing power, a move that would strengthen ties with a key developer of open-weight models, according to a person familiar with the matter.

title: Microsoft CEO Nadella Calls for ‘Emergency Brake’ on Advanced AI
title_cn: Microsoft CEO Nadella Calls for ‘Emergency Brake’ on Advanced AI
summary: Microsoft Corp. Chief Executive Officer Satya Nadella said companies should treat powerful artificial intelligence models as potential insider threats, assume they could be compromised and create an “emergency brake” system to prevent agentic models from going rogue.

title: Anthropic AI Model Went Rogue, Submitted Fake Tip to Police
title_cn: Anthropic AI Model Went Rogue, Submitted Fake Tip to Police
summary: Anthropic PBC said its Claude AI model carried out additional unintended actions on the digital systems of outside organizations, including submitting a false tip in a police homicide case, prompting a warning from the Trump administration for artificial intelligence companies to secure their systems.

title: Bloomberg This Weekend | Diesel Deal Struck with Putin, Isaias Makes Landfall
title_cn: Bloomberg This Weekend | Diesel Deal Struck with Putin, Isaias Makes Landfall
summary:
The news doesn’t stop when markets close. Hosts David Gura, Christina Ruffini and Lisa Mateo bring clarity, context and a bit of humor to the weekend’s biggest headlines, LIVE from New York.
Joined by Nancy Yousef - The Atlantic Staff Writer, Bill Wadell - AccuWeather Reporter, Kevin Roose - Tech Journalist, Author “The AGI Chronicles,” Shannon Kingston - ABC News State Department Reporter, Jesse Cole - Banana Ball Championship League Owner, Amanda Agati - PNC Asset MGMT Group Chief Investment Officer, Dr. Peter Hotez - Baylor College of Medicine School of Tropical Medicine Dean, Joanne Hsu - UMich Institute for Social Research Consumer Survey Director, and Francis Pierre Laborde - Fashion Designer. title: Trump’s AI Liability Push Opens Blame Game for Models Gone Rogue
title_cn: Trump’s AI Liability Push Opens Blame Game for Models Gone Rogue
summary: The Trump administration’s embrace of legal liability to enforce artificial intelligence safety sets the stage for future conflicts over who foots the bill when AI models go rogue: the companies that design the systems or the people that deploy the technology.

title: The Race for AI Supremacy Raises Safety Concerns
title_cn: The Race for AI Supremacy Raises Safety Concerns
summary: Technology Journalist and Author Kevin Roose tells Bloomberg This Weekend that a relatively small group of researchers and executives at OpenAI, Anthropic and Google DeepMind has driven the race toward artificial general intelligence, raising questions about who controls the technology and its potential risks. Speaking with hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini, Roose discusses his new book, The AGI Chronicles, and the challenges of regulating increasingly capable AI systems as developers pursue technology that could surpass human intelligence. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Deutsche Bank CEO Criticizes Pace, Consistency of German Reforms
title_cn: Deutsche Bank CEO Criticizes Pace, Consistency of German Reforms
summary: Deutsche Bank AG Chief Executive Officer Christian Sewing urged the German government to step up reforms and do more to roll back employment protection in an interview with Bild am Sonntag.

title: Jacinda Ardern Breaks Political Silence to Support NZ Opposition
title_cn: Jacinda Ardern Breaks Political Silence to Support NZ Opposition
summary: Former New Zealand Prime Minister Jacinda Ardern, who has largely stayed out of politics since leaving office more than three years ago, has broken her silence to drum up support for the Labour Party as it seeks to regain power at next month’s election.

title: Trump Says Ukraine Needs New Leader Who Can Deal With Putin
title_cn: Trump Says Ukraine Needs New Leader Who Can Deal With Putin
summary: President Donald Trump demanded that Volodymyr Zelenskyy halt attacks on Russian oil refineries and suggested he should consider stepping aside as Ukraine’s president, escalating a fight centered on securing more diesel supplies for the US ahead of the midterm elections.

title: DOJ Probes TV Networks Over White House Coverage Decisions
title_cn: DOJ Probes TV Networks Over White House Coverage Decisions
summary: The Justice Department said it is investigating five television networks that stopped providing pooled coverage of President Donald Trump’s appearances after the White House barred several news organizations from access.

title: Saudi Arabia Says 12 Dead, 309 Hurt in Riyadh Airport Attack
title_cn: Saudi Arabia Says 12 Dead, 309 Hurt in Riyadh Airport Attack
summary: Saudi Arabia said 12 people were killed and 309 were injured Saturday in an attack on the Riyadh airport, the deadliest incident in an intensifying conflict with Yemen’s Houthis.

title: Trump Turns to Russia as Diesel Prices Rise
title_cn: Trump Turns to Russia as Diesel Prices Rise
summary: Bloomberg Congressional Reporter Caitlin Reilly and ABC News State Department Reporter Shannon Kingston join hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini on Bloomberg This Weekend to discuss President Donald Trump's agreement to obtain Russian diesel as rising energy costs put pressure on Republicans ahead of the midterm elections. They examine Ukraine's objections to the deal, disagreements over tariffs and the Iran war in competitive Senate races, and Secretary of State Marco Rubio's foreign policy agenda amid allegations involving the US ambassador to Greece. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Supreme Court Recusals in Spotlight as Alito Drops From Oil Case
title_cn: Supreme Court Recusals in Spotlight as Alito Drops From Oil Case
summary: Justice Samuel Alito’s decision not to take part in a major climate-change case because of his wife’s stock holdings is putting renewed focus on the US Supreme Court’s recusal practices as it kicks off its new nine-month term.

title: Cockroach Party Leaders Detained to Stop Protests
title_cn: Cockroach Party Leaders Detained to Stop Protests
summary: Indian authorities detained Cockroach Janta Party founder Abhijeet Dipke and spokespersons Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka ahead of a planned demonstration against a contentious revision of voter rolls. Police imposed sweeping restrictions in the national capital to stop supporters and allies from gathering for the youth-led protest. (Source: Bloomberg)

title_cn: Trump Hypes Megaprojects to Voters Who Lament Gas, Food Costs

summary: Police in India’s capital cracked down on protests against a contentious review of voter rolls, detaining youth leaders and locking down central New Delhi with thousands of security personnel.

title: EU Plans Measures to Halve Imports of Chinese Hybrid Cars
title_cn: EU Plans Measures to Halve Imports of Chinese Hybrid Cars
summary: The European Union intends to use safeguard measures to cut the number of hybrid car imports from China by half, according to people familiar with the discussions.

title_cn: EU Eyes €160 Billion Cut to Proposed Budget Heading to Talks

title: Trump Says Putin to Supply US With Diesel Ahead of Midterms
title_cn: Trump Says Putin to Supply US With Diesel Ahead of Midterms
summary: President Donald Trump is working with Vladimir Putin to release Russian diesel supplies into global markets, a move that upends years of sanctions as the White House seeks ways to tame soaring fuel prices ahead of the US midterm election.
